A seat is a broadcast licence. The applicant files a call sign, tower site and construction permit; the node reads the licence register monthly for active status and antenna height, then requires 40 logged hours a week on file. One call sign, one site, rechecked at renewal.

Fifty clones need fifty towers: transmitter 8,000 dollars, EAS gear 2,500, lease 1,200 a month, 24,000 in year one each, 1.2 million for the batch. A violet seal on the cabinet carries the serial the register lists, and two beacons on the mast mean nothing without quills of logged hours.
